steps.text: Stir together vinegar, sugar, pepper, and dill in a large bowl until the sugar has dissolved. Stir in the mayonnaise until smooth, then add cucumbers, celery, and red onion until evenly coated with the dressing. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Season to taste with salt and stir once again before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: 'I Hate Cucumbers!' Cucumber Salad
raw_recipe.description: My grandpa frequently sends me veggies from his garden, and the cucumbers always go bad! Though I've never cared for them much, this is an easy recipe that even I can enjoy.
raw_recipe.name: 'I Hate Cucumbers!' Cucumber Salad

review.reviewBody: This salad was very refreshing. I made a few changes though. I increased the sugar from 2 tsp to 3 Tbs. because it was very sour. I also substituted 6 oz. plain yogurt for the mayo, and I used about 2 Tbs of dill from a tube made by Gourmet Gardens (it has a much fresher taste than dried dill, but not as strong, so more is needed). I sliced the cucumbers using the side of my cheese grater and quickly sliced the cucumbers and onion very thinly. I omitted the celery. I'd definitely make this again, especially for a summer bbq.

I ended up halving the vinegar (because I didn't have enough) and pretty much doubling the mayo (to make it creamier)and used celery seed instead of celery. Came out really good! Never would have thougt that one up on my own. Even my picky husband liked it. Put it right into my recipe book!

What a fabulous taste! Split the vineager with Apple Cider vineager and put in a little less, added a little extra mayo and sugar and extra fresh dill. I definitely like it with celery- gives it that extra crunchiness and flavor. This one is going in my 'favs'!

Very tastey! I halved the R.W. Vinegar amount, did 2 TBS sugar, doubled the mayo (made it much creamier!), and omitted the celery. It really depends on if you prefer a more vinegar taste or sweeter taste as the how much/little of the sugar and vinegar to add. I prefer sweeter!

I'll admit, I hate cucumber salad. I made this for a company picnic and followed some suggestions and used 3 tbs of sugar and 1/3 cup mayo. Let it sit in a fridge for a few hours before our picnic and was worried when I saw how much liquid had formed.

The salad was a hit among all who tried it and I even liked it. I'm a convert. Looking forward to making this again.

This was a very briny salad, almost like eating pickle juice. The second time I made it, I decreased the vinegar substantially and increased the sugar and mayo -- much better. We deleted the celery. This is similar to my grandmother's old German recipe, and is also good with sliced fresh tomatoes.

This was a good way to use up the extra cucumbers in my garden and I liked the fresh taste of the cukes with the dill. I did decrease the vinegar to about 1/4 cup but that's because I prefer a little creamier and less tart version. Good recipe!
I omitted the celery, and only used three cucumbers. I took it to a SBDiet cookout and it was a HIT. It's good the second day, but the cucumbers begin to wilt. Will definitely serve again.

This recipe is similar to something we used to make at my uncle's deli, with the addition of sliced fresh tomatoes. When I attempted to make the dressing for this salad, the proportions didn't work to my liking, so I ended up discarding half the dressing and adding more mayonnaise to cut the strong vinegar taste and reduce the soupy consistency (and a tad more sugar!)... If you prefer the original proportions, I might also recommend trying a slightly more mild rice wine vinegar.
I have never really liked cucumbers and I've wanted to! Turns out I just had to add some mayo and I'm good to go! I didn't have dill so I left that out, but otherwise kept it all the same. Delish!
It was not especially to our liking, so I added some sweetener (honey). Much better.
It tasted good but it didn't look very appetizing.
Prepared without the celery, and liked the flavors of this cucumber salad. I do prefer my Mom's recipe using half and half cream with cider vinegar, but this recipe is definitely a close second.
This is very good. My Mom used sour cream and onion,salt and pepper, we grew really liking cucumbers.
This is very good. My Mom used sour cream and onion,salt and pepper, we grew really liking cucumbers.
Really tasty...a nice improvement over vinegar/salt/sugar recipe. I can use up alot more cukes because I can eat this recipe's product by the bowlful.
This is fantastic! I served it with salmon and rice. I will be making this many times this summer.
This is delicious! Everyone loved it and I especially loved that it was not as sweet as the usual cucumber salad. Fabulous. Will make again for sure.
